title: Close the loop to user intent
statement: As a product and release owner, I can trace implementation evidence back to an accepted user story so completion gaps are visible.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Deck, slide, or Item explanations link to a story or criterion through a revision-pinned relation.
Traceability can be followed from an accepted criterion to exact diff evidence and in reverse from an exact diff or current committed head.
Item evidence without a current path to an accepted story is reported explicitly, while revised requirements or missing visual targets stale their links.
Commit reverse lookup is limited to the active committed comparison head and refuses WORKTREE comparisons.
